minutes.headline: Finance Committee recommended disapproval of both TC Passios articles (7 and 8) but declined to recommend passing them over.
minutes.summary: Second public hearing for the special town meeting on articles 3, 7 and 8. Article 3 (fire union agreement) was deferred. After a long presentation on renovating or rebuilding TC Passios, the committee voted to recommend disapproval of both articles, then rejected a separate motion to recommend passing them over. A consent calendar was also endorsed.

what_happened.line: The Finance Committee voted 4-2 to recommend disapproval of article 7, the TC Passios renovation.
The committee voted unanimously to recommend disapproval of article 8, the design development funds.
A separate motion to recommend that articles 7 and 8 be passed over failed 4-2.
Article 3, the fire union agreement, was deferred again for lack of information.
The committee endorsed the consent calendar of articles 5, 9, 10, 11, 12 and 13 by 6-0.

why_it_matters: Articles 7 and 8 would commit town money to designing a TC Passios renovation or rebuild, and the committee's recommendation will be in front of voters at the special town meeting.
The committee heard that a policy limit on excludable debt would be exceeded for years at the higher cost figures, which bears on future tax bills.
watch_next: Finance Committee meets at 6 p.m. on November 16 to re-caucus on article 3, ahead of the special town meeting that evening.
Last business meeting is set for December 9, with Chapter 70 follow-up, street lights and ARPA items.
